about: Small data files read by scripts/figures. Source fields and columns give a path from the repository root when the file is published, and otherwise the plain name of a working record that is not published. Scores are NDCG over feeds: validation 14,423 feeds, public 8,562 test feeds, private 20,033.

public_scores.csv.what: The 40 scored submissions in the order their public score was logged.

columns.date_utc: day on which the score was logged
columns.logged_utc: time the score was logged; empty for the first four files, whose send time was not recorded
columns.short_id: name of the file in the working records
columns.label: plain description used in figures
columns.public_ndcg: public score with the precision of the record
columns.val_ndcg: validation score of the file; empty when none was computed
columns.val_usable: 0 when the validation score is missing or inflated by the later-feed leak
columns.in_level_fit: 1 for the 18 files behind the level line of level_line.json
columns.is_team_best: 1 when the score was strictly above every earlier team score (it stays 1 after a later file beats it)
columns.members_train_on: whether the members' training held out the 30,000 holdout feeds
columns.file: file name of the submission parquet

public_scores.csv.derived_from: the submission notes of the lab, the status log (including its part of 2026-11-11) and the decision ledger, none of them published; the source column names the record and the date or block of each entry. Rows 31 to 40 (17 to 19 Nov) come from the decision ledger alone; their validation scores were re-read from the stored pools (not published; rows 31 to 37 on 2026-11-18, rows 38 to 40 on 2026-11-19) and agree with the ledger to 0.00001.

leaderboard.csv.what: Eight fetched snapshots of the public board and three rows in which only the team score is new.
leaderboard.csv.derived_from: status log entries (not published), lab/nn_x/audit/top1/out_lb_snapshot_2026-11-12T2200Z.txt, the decision ledger block 2026-11-17T23:46:07Z (not published) for the row of 2026-11-17, and the public leaderboard page fetched on 2026-11-18T03:33:53Z and 2026-11-19T03:34:51Z
leaderboard.csv.note: No snapshot was fetched between 2026-11-13T19:43Z and 2026-11-18T03:33Z; the rival scores of the rows in between are carried forward. Other teams appear by rank only.

level_line.json.what: The line public = 0.0074 + 0.963 x validation and the files it was fitted on.
level_line.json.derived_from: lab/reports/RECHECK_1114/lb_stats.md section 1.1; decision ledger block 2026-11-15T20:30:59Z (not published)

final_picks.json.what: The two files selected for the private leaderboard (file, sha256, scores, members) and the earlier picks 1 and 2.
final_picks.json.derived_from: decision ledger blocks 2026-11-18T02:33:28Z and 2026-11-19T03:32:47Z (not published); sha256 checked against the submission files (not published) on 2026-11-19

calendar.csv.what: Feeds per calendar day (Moscow time) in train, the 30,000-feed holdout, validation and test, with the public and private parts of each test day.
calendar.csv.derived_from: timestamps of the feeds.parquet of each flattened split (not published); the holdout is redrawn with the trainer's rule (exploration probability above 0.9, 50 or more candidates, seed 12345); public is timestamp < 1790497920

staleness.csv.what: Mean days since a candidate item was last seen in train (items seen in train only) and the mean feed time, per evaluation set.
staleness.csv.derived_from: lab/reports/DATA_PIPELINE_1113.md section 3.1 for the days; the feeds.parquet of each flattened split (not published) for the mean times

pipeline_stages.csv.what: The nine stages of the final pipeline with hardware, recorded run time and GPU-hours.
pipeline_stages.csv.derived_from: the solution notes of the lab (not published) and the logs named in the source column (not published)
pipeline_stages.csv.note: GPU-hours are sums of the logged wall-clock minutes of runs on shared GPUs, so they are upper bounds.

model.json.what: Widths, counts and parameter totals of the ranker.
model.json.derived_from: lab/nn_x/w5/model.py and the configuration stored in the checkpoints of the final members (checkpoints not published)

distillation.json.what: Teacher composition, the target weight and the three gains shown in the distillation figure.
distillation.json.derived_from: decision ledger, read-out 2026-11-14T05:18:17Z and block of 2026-11-14 17:32Z (not published); the teacher dump logs (not published)

ensemble.json.what: Mix weights and the validation scores of the branches of the two final files, of FD16P20 (pick 1 until 2026-11-18) and of W8P20 (pick 2 until 2026-11-19).
ensemble.json.derived_from: lab/nn_x/w12/kd/build_r4.py and lab/nn_x/w12/kd/build_r3.py; a rebuild of FD16P20 and W8P20 from the stored member predictions on 2026-11-16; the stored pools of FD16P20@m0.4_0.2 read on 2026-11-18 and of FDX16P20:ps on 2026-11-19 (stored predictions and pools are not published)

near_copies.csv.what: Public scores of the 17 scored files of the final family (full-view distilled students plus popularity-light students) and the paired standard error of each difference to FD16P20.

columns.label: one-line description used in the figure; short feeds have fewer than 50 candidates, long feeds 50 or more
columns.paired_se_vs_fd16p20: standard deviation of the per-feed validation difference to FD16P20 divided by sqrt(8562), the formula of lab/nn_x/w12/kd/build_r4.py
columns.se_source: ledger: as logged in the decision ledger (not published) when the score was read; recomputed: the same formula applied on 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19 to the stored validation pools (not published), which reproduces the logged values to 0.00001 (the ledger gives about 0.0003 for FD16P20@m0.4_0.2 and about 0.00037 for FDXH16P20:ps)
columns.final_pick: 1 or 2 for the two final picks, 0 otherwise

experiments_outcomes.csv.what: Number of catalogue entries per theme and outcome, one row per theme of docs/07-what-failed.md.
experiments_outcomes.csv.derived_from: the catalogue tables of docs/07-what-failed.md, counted by scripts/figures/count_catalogue.py (run it after every edit of the catalogue; --check reports a mismatch)
experiments_outcomes.csv.note: label is a shortened theme name for the figure; three themes are shortened.

work_loop.json.what: Counts behind the work-loop figure: days, messages from the person, context summaries of the lead session, workflows, uploads per day.
work_loop.json.derived_from: the working records of the project (not published), 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-19
work_loop.json.note: The message count is approximate (about 165). The lower panel of the figure is a design from docs/13-how-the-work-was-run.md and has no data.
